{"type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01PR3Srb6B9mBn7fso7bJicK","type":"tool_result","content":"===== TASK.md =====\nImplement withdraw per SPEC.md; make `python -m unittest` pass.^M$\n\n===== ewallet/__init__.py =====\n\n===== ewallet/wallet.py =====\nclass EWallet:^M$\n    \"\"\"A simple wallet that holds a balance.\"\"\"^M$\n^M$\n    def __init__(self, balance=0):^M$\n        self.balance = balance^M$\n^M$\n    def withdraw(self, amount):^M$\n        \"\"\"Withdraw amount from the wallet. See SPEC.md.\"\"\"^M$\n        raise NotImplementedError^M$\n\n===== tests/__init__.py =====\n\n===== tests/test_wallet.py =====\nimport unittest^M$\n^M$\nfrom ewallet.wallet import EWallet^M$\n^M$\n^M$\nclass TestWithdraw(unittest.TestCase):^M$\n    def test_valid_withdrawal_deducts_amount(self):^M$\n        wallet = EWallet(balance=100)^M$\n        self.assertTrue(wallet.withdraw(30))^M$\n        self.assertEqual(wallet.balance, 70)^M$\n^M$\n    def test_withdrawal_exceeding_balance_rejected(self):^M$\n        wallet = EWallet(balance=100)^M$\n        self.assertFalse(wallet.withdraw(150))^M$\n        self.assertEqual(wallet.balance, 100)^M$\n^M$\n    def test_exact_balance_withdrawal_rejected(self):^M$\n        wallet = EWallet(balance=100)^M$\n        self.assertFalse(wallet.withdraw(100))^M$\n        self.assertEqual(wallet.balance, 100)^M$\n^M$\n    def test_zero_withdrawal_rejected(self):^M$\n        wallet = EWallet(balance=100)^M$\n        self.assertFalse(wallet.withdraw(0))^M$\n        self.assertEqual(wallet.balance, 100)^M$\n^M$\n    def test_negative_withdrawal_rejected(self):^M$\n        wallet = EWallet(balance=100)^M$\n        self.assertFalse(wallet.withdraw(-10))^M$\n        self.assertEqual(wallet.balance, 100)^M$\n^M$\n    def test_non_integer_withdrawals_rejected(self):^M$\n        for amount in (10.0, \"10\", None, True, False):^M$\n            with self.subTest(amount=amount):^M$\n                wallet = EWallet(balance=100)^M$\n                self.assertFalse(wallet.withdraw(amount))^M$\n                self.assertEqual(wallet.balance, 100)^M$\n^M$\n^M$\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":^M$\n    unittest.main()^M$","is_error":false}]},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"045c7f05-d825-43e1-9a91-44b654674068","uuid":"a6445e93-162f-4d3b-8a09-0383e921d2ea","timestamp":"2026-10-20T09:18:33.327Z","tool_use_result":{"stdout":"===== TASK.md =====\nImplement withdraw per SPEC.md;
